name: Orbit
description: A multiplayer text game on a space station orbiting the Earth, the hub of a shared simulation. Walk its three decks by compass, chat in the Cantina, look down at Indonesia from the Observation Deck, work your job, grow real-time crops in your own plots, mine the Asteroid Belt, shop on the Mall Ring, trade with other players, try the casino, and climb the ranks and leaderboards. Play in its window or from Aruna, typed or spoken: "orbit utara", "orbit bilang halo", "orbit harian", "orbit status". Other players speak in voices of their own (Hariku Voice), with recorded and generated sounds from the side things happen on, and quiet ambience. Connects only when you play; the server keeps your character (name, job, description, credits, things, progress) and a hash of a secret made on your computer, and passes chat on without storing it. Credits are only for playing: no real money.
author: Rafli
